skill_name: Develop an original story with the topic "home".
workflow: Ivan was always told to appreciate the home that he was fortunate to have and he did. Despite his family’s cramped and crowded living space, he was grateful for their roof, the safety it afforded, and the warmth it provided. All too often, though, this sense of home was fleeting. The stress of balancing work and school weighed on his parents, as did the knowledge of their growing debt each month.
